description:
About Reli. Oxo-Biodegradable Trash Bags:

Each trash bag uses ASTM 6954-certified EPI TDPA additives for oxo-biodegradability. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation.  EPI TDPA technology enables products made from polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP) and polystyrene (PS) to degrade at a controlled rate (over many years) when in an appropriate commercial compost facility environment including, for example, photo (sunlight), thermal (heat) and/or mechanical stress in the presence of oxygen, moisture, and microorganisms. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation; stated rates and extent of decomposition do not mean that the product will continue to decompose. Commercial compost facilities can be found throughout the United States, locatable via local governments and online search.

Examples of EPI TDPA Application: LDPE-TDPA oxidized samples go through significant biodegradation (50 – 60% by carbon dioxide evolution) over 18 months as mediated by soil micro-organisms. EPI TDPA-incorporated PE bags can speed up degradation by 100's to 1000's of times faster compared to conventional PE bags when tested under ASTM D5282 Outdoor Exposure Testing Guidelines. EPI TDPA can facilitate total degradation of polyethylene carrier bags within 24 - 36 months with the appropriate formulation and disposal environment.

Each case includes 500 Trash Bags developed and distributed using Reli's global and domestic operations to enable premium quality with wholesale quantity & prices.

All of the bags are green in color to provide a visually appealing look while indicating eco-friendliness and hiding trash bag contents.

title: Tufpak 1312-2436 Autoclavable Biohazard Bags, Orange, 24 x 36" (61 x 91cm)
bullet_point: [Polypropylene, Autoclavable to 275°f, Meets impact strength for all 50 states, Meets tear strength for all 50 states]
description:
Biohazard infectious waste is typically collected at the point of generation in such places as hospital laboratory and operating areas, pharmaceutical, biological, university and other related laboratories. The most widely used container of such waste is plastic bags. State regulations demand the proper handling and disposal of such waste. Within these regulations are clear specifications for the film from which such bags are made. In all cases, proper containment of hazardous infectious material requires the bags to meet various strength standards. Individual States regulate separately, resulting in range specifications. All States require a clearly stated need for the bag to resist a specified impact to reduce the likelihood of bursting. Some States go further, requiring a minimum resistance to tearing, so as to reduce likelihood of a puncture, propagating into a major opening.

title: TheSafetyHouse 30" x 40" x 6 Mil Black Asbestos Bags 75/case
bullet_point: [30" x 40" x 6 Mil, Black, 75/case]
description: TheSafetyHouse's asbestos disposal bags meet industry standards, or better. They are printed with identifying symbols and verbiage stating that the contents as asbestos materials. These asbestos disposal bags are necessary for anyone who wishes to safely remove and properly dispose of asbestos from their home or business, keeping in mind that the goal is to keep exposure to asbestos to a minimum. Proper asbestos disposal bags are required in order to meet OSHA safety standards. These asbestos disposal bags come in black and clear. Asbestos disposal bags are made of industrial weight polyethylene and have an approved asbestos warning on them that says Danger/Contains Asbestos Fibers/Avoid Creating Dust/Cancer and Lung Disease Hazard. Regulations require that you put asbestos material into the asbestos disposal bags while it is still damp. The asbestos disposal bags should not have more than thirty to fifty pounds of material placed in them. You should check the rules for disposal of asbestos in your area to see what their regulations are for the weight of asbestos disposal bags. Many places require you to double bag your asbestos waste using the asbestos disposal bags and sealing each of the asbestos disposal bags with duct tape. Asbestos can never be disposed of in the regular trash, even if it is properly labeled. Disposal of asbestos is only allowed at certain locations, and there is a charge for disposing of asbestos, usually this depends on the weight of the asbestos you wish to dispose of. It must be properly contained in asbestos disposal bags and you must have the proper paperwork in order to dispose of your asbestos disposal bags. Some disposal locations are only open on certain days, so be sure to check this beforehand.

description:
About Reli. Oxo-Biodegradable Trash Bags:

Each trash bag uses ASTM 6954-certified EPI TDPA additives for oxo-biodegradability. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation.  EPI TDPA technology enables products made from polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP) and polystyrene (PS) to degrade at a controlled rate (over many years) when in an appropriate commercial compost facility environment including, for example, photo (sunlight), thermal (heat) and/or mechanical stress in the presence of oxygen, moisture, and microorganisms. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation; stated rates and extent of decomposition do not mean that the product will continue to decompose. Commercial compost facilities can be found throughout the United States, locatable via local governments and online search.

Examples of EPI TDPA Application: LDPE-TDPA oxidized samples go through significant biodegradation (50 – 60% by carbon dioxide evolution) over 18 months as mediated by soil micro-organisms. EPI TDPA-incorporated PE bags can speed up degradation by 100's to 1000's of times faster compared to conventional PE bags when tested under ASTM D5282 Outdoor Exposure Testing Guidelines. EPI TDPA can facilitate total degradation of polyethylene carrier bags within 24 - 36 months with the appropriate formulation and disposal environment.

Each case includes 250 Trash Bags developed and distributed using Reli's global and domestic operations to enable premium quality with wholesale quantity & prices.

All of the bags are green in color to provide a visually appealing look while indicating eco-friendliness and hiding trash bag contents.

description:
About Reli. Oxo-Biodegradable Trash Bags:

Each trash bag uses ASTM 6954-certified EPI TDPA additives for oxo-biodegradability. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation.  EPI TDPA technology enables products made from polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP) and polystyrene (PS) to degrade at a controlled rate (over many years) when in an appropriate commercial compost facility environment including, for example, photo (sunlight), thermal (heat) and/or mechanical stress in the presence of oxygen, moisture, and microorganisms. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation; stated rates and extent of decomposition do not mean that the product will continue to decompose. Commercial compost facilities can be found throughout the United States, locatable via local governments and online search.

Examples of EPI TDPA Application: LDPE-TDPA oxidized samples go through significant biodegradation (50 – 60% by carbon dioxide evolution) over 18 months as mediated by soil micro-organisms. EPI TDPA-incorporated PE bags can speed up degradation by 100's to 1000's of times faster compared to conventional PE bags when tested under ASTM D5282 Outdoor Exposure Testing Guidelines. EPI TDPA can facilitate total degradation of polyethylene carrier bags within 24 - 36 months with the appropriate formulation and disposal environment.

Each case includes 500 Trash Bags developed and distributed using Reli's global and domestic operations to enable premium quality with wholesale quantity & prices.

All of the bags are green in color to provide a visually appealing look while indicating eco-friendliness and hiding trash bag contents.

description:
About Reli. Oxo-Biodegradable Trash Bags:

Each trash bag uses ASTM 6954-certified EPI TDPA additives for oxo-biodegradability. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation.  EPI TDPA technology enables products made from polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP) and polystyrene (PS) to degrade at a controlled rate (over many years) when in an appropriate commercial compost facility environment including, for example, photo (sunlight), thermal (heat) and/or mechanical stress in the presence of oxygen, moisture, and microorganisms. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation; stated rates and extent of decomposition do not mean that the product will continue to decompose. Commercial compost facilities can be found throughout the United States, locatable via local governments and online search.

Examples of EPI TDPA Application: LDPE-TDPA oxidized samples go through significant biodegradation (50 – 60% by carbon dioxide evolution) over 18 months as mediated by soil micro-organisms. EPI TDPA-incorporated PE bags can speed up degradation by 100's to 1000's of times faster compared to conventional PE bags when tested under ASTM D5282 Outdoor Exposure Testing Guidelines. EPI TDPA can facilitate total degradation of polyethylene carrier bags within 24 - 36 months with the appropriate formulation and disposal environment.

Each case includes 250 Trash Bags developed and distributed using Reli's global and domestic operations to enable premium quality with wholesale quantity & prices.

All of the bags are green in color to provide a visually appealing look while indicating eco-friendliness and hiding trash bag contents.

These asbestos disposal bags are necessary for anyone who wishes to safely remove and properly dispose of asbestos from their home or business, keeping in mind that the goal is to keep exposure to asbestos to a minimum. Proper asbestos disposal bags are required in order to meet OSHA safety standards. These asbestos disposal bags come in black and clear. Asbestos disposal bags are made of industrial weight polyethylene and have an approved asbestos warning on them that says Danger/Contains Asbestos Fibers/Avoid Creating Dust/Cancer and Lung Disease Hazard. Regulations require that you put asbestos material into the asbestos disposal bags while it is still damp. The asbestos disposal bags should not have more than thirty to fifty pounds of material placed in them. You should check the rules for disposal of asbestos in your area to see what their regulations are for the weight of asbestos disposal bags. Many places require you to double bag your asbestos waste using the asbestos disposal bags and sealing each of the asbestos disposal bags with duct tape. Asbestos can never be disposed of in the regular trash, even if it is properly labeled. Disposal of asbestos is only allowed at certain locations, and there is a charge for disposing of asbestos, usually this depends on the weight of the asbestos you wish to dispose of. It must be properly contained in asbestos disposal bags and you must have the proper paperwork in order to dispose of your asbestos disposal bags. Some disposal locations are only open on certain days, so be sure to check this beforehand.

description:
Biohazard infectious waste is typically collected at the point of generation in such places as hospital laboratory and operating areas, pharmaceutical, biological, university and other related laboratories. The most widely used container of such waste is plastic bags. State regulations demand the proper handling and disposal of such waste. Within these regulations are clear specifications for the film from which such bags are made. In all cases, proper containment of hazardous infectious material requires the bags to meet various strength standards. Individual States regulate separately, resulting in range specifications. All States require a clearly stated need for the bag to resist a specified impact to reduce the likelihood of bursting. Some States go further, requiring a minimum resistance to tearing, so as to reduce likelihood of a puncture, propagating into a major opening.

Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation.  EPI TDPA technology enables products made from polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP) and polystyrene (PS) to degrade at a controlled rate (over many years) when in an appropriate commercial compost facility environment including, for example, photo (sunlight), thermal (heat) and/or mechanical stress in the presence of oxygen, moisture, and microorganisms. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation; stated rates and extent of decomposition do not mean that the product will continue to decompose. Commercial compost facilities can be found throughout the United States, locatable via local governments and online search.

EPI TDPA can facilitate total degradation of polyethylene carrier bags within 24 - 36 months with the appropriate formulation and disposal environment.

title: Dekor Classic Diaper Pail Biodegradable Refills | 2 Count | Most Economical Refill System | Quick and Simple to Replace | No Preset Bag Size – Use Only What You Need | Exclusive End-of-Liner Marking
bullet_point: [Biodegradable Alternative to Ordinary Refills, Use with Dekor Classic Hands-Free Diaper Pail, No Preset Perforations or Bag Size, Empty As Often As You Want, Use Only As Much Refill As Needed, NEW End of Liner Marking - Helpful Reminder Before You Run Out!, Fresh Powder Scent Helps Neutralize Odors, Each Box Contains 2 Refills and Holds Up to 990 Newborn Diapers]
description:
Dekor Classic Biodegradable Refills break down more quickly than ordinary refills. As defined in ASTM 1991, "A Biodegradable Plastic is defined as a degradable plastic in which the degradation results from the action of naturally occurring microorganisms such as bacteria, fungi, and algae." Each Dekor Refill is one long continuous liner with no preset perforations or size, which means you can empty as often as you want—whether it’s after one particularly stinky change, or when the pail is totally stuffed—and use only what you need. Emptying the pail is super-easy. Simply cut the refill with the kid-safe cutter located inside the access door, discard, and tie a new knot in the remaining bag. Dekor Classic Biodegradable Refills are made of 20% recycled materials and infused with a fresh baby powder scent that helps neutralize odors. Each box contains 2 refills and holds up to 990 newborn diapers.

Los recambios biodegradables de Dekor Classic se descomponen más rápidamente que los recambios normales. Según se define en ASTM 1991, "Un plástico biodegradable se define como un plástico degradable en el que la degradación resulta de la acción de microorganismos naturales como bacterias, hongos y algas". Cada recambio Dekor es un revestimiento continuo largo sin perforaciones preestablecidas o tamaño, lo que significa que puedes vaciar tantas veces como quieras —ya sea después de un cambio particularmente apestoso o cuando el cubo está totalmente relleno— y usar solo lo que necesitas. Vaciar el cubo es súper fácil. Simplemente corta el relleno con el cortador seguro para niños ubicado dentro de la puerta de acceso, descarte y ata un nuevo nudo en la bolsa restante. Los recambios biodegradables Dekor Classic están hechos de materiales reciclados 20% e impregnados con un aroma fresco de polvo para bebés que ayuda a neutralizar los olores. Cada caja contiene 2 recambios y tiene capacidad para 990 pañales recién nacidos.

מילויים מתכלים קלאסיים של Dekor מתפרקים מהר יותר מאשר מילויים רגילים. כפי שהוגדר ב-ASTM 1991, "פלסטיק מתכלה מוגדר כפלסטיק מתכלה בו ההשפעה נובעת מפעולת מיקרואורגניזמים טבעיים כגון חיידקים, פטריות ואצות." כל מילוי Dekor הוא ליינר רציף אחד ללא ניקובים או גודל מוגדרים מראש, מה שאומר שאתם יכולים לרוקן לעתים קרובות ככל שתרצו - בין אם זה אחרי שינוי אחד מסריח במיוחד, או כאשר הפח ממולא לחלוטין - ולהשתמש רק במה שאתם צריכים. ריקון הפח הוא קל במיוחד. פשוט חתכו את המילוי עם החותך הבטוח לילדים הממוקם בתוך דלת הגישה, זרקו וקשרו קשר חדש בתיק הנותר. המילויים המתכלים הקלאסיים של Dekor עשויים מ-20% חומרים ממוחזרים ומוחדרים בניחוח אבקת תינוק טרי המסייע לנטרל ריחות. כל קופסה מכילה 2 מילויים ומחזיקה עד 990 חיתולים לתינוק.

Dekor-Classic-Nachfüllpackungen sind biologisch abbaubar als herkömmliche Nachfüllpackungen. Wie in ASTM 1991 definiert, "Ein biologisch abbaubarer Kunststoff ist als abbaubarer Kunststoff definiert, bei dem der Abbau aus der Wirkung von natürlich vorkommenden Mikroorganismen wie Bakterien, Pilze und Algen resultiert." Jede Dekor Nachfüllpackung ist ein langer, durchgehender Liner ohne voreingestellte Perforationen oder Größe, was bedeutet, dass Sie so oft entleeren können, wie Sie möchten – ob es nach einer besonders stinkenden Änderung ist, oder wenn der Eimer vollständig gefüllt ist – und nur das, was Sie brauchen. Das Entleeren des Eimers ist super einfach. Einfach die Nachfüllpackung mit dem kindersicheren Cutter in der Zugangstür zuschneiden, entsorgen und einen neuen Knoten in der restlichen Tasche binden. Dekor-Classic-Nachfüllpackungen sind aus 20 % recycelten Materialien hergestellt und mit einem frischen Babypuderduft angereichert, der hilft, Gerüche zu neutralisieren. Jede Box enthält 2 Nachfüllpackungen und fasst bis zu 990 Windeln für Neugeborene.

But perhaps most importantly is what affect our bag would have on the environment. One of our top priorities is to minimize our global footprint. Besides cleaning up the mess now, we want to make sure we are not creating messes for generations to come. Plastic is a hot topic in current environmental issue discussions. But, some companies are responsible with their plastic production and we are proud to be in that category. Doggie Walk Bags are are made from recycled plastics. Also convenient for dirty diaper disposal, cat litter pick-up, car trash, camping waste, dirty gym clothes, wet bathing suits, and car, boat, or air sickness needs. description:
About Reli. Oxo-Biodegradable Trash Bags:

Each trash bag uses ASTM 6954-certified EPI TDPA additives for oxo-biodegradability. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation.  EPI TDPA technology enables products made from polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP) and polystyrene (PS) to degrade at a controlled rate (over many years) when in an appropriate commercial compost facility environment including, for example, photo (sunlight), thermal (heat) and/or mechanical stress in the presence of oxygen, moisture, and microorganisms. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation; stated rates and extent of decomposition do not mean that the product will continue to decompose. Commercial compost facilities can be found throughout the United States, locatable via local governments and online search.

Examples of EPI TDPA Application: LDPE-TDPA oxidized samples go through significant biodegradation (50 – 60% by carbon dioxide evolution) over 18 months as mediated by soil micro-organisms. EPI TDPA-incorporated PE bags can speed up degradation by 100's to 1000's of times faster compared to conventional PE bags when tested under ASTM D5282 Outdoor Exposure Testing Guidelines. EPI TDPA can facilitate total degradation of polyethylene carrier bags within 24 - 36 months with the appropriate formulation and disposal environment.

description:
BigMouth Leaf and Lawn Bag Holder

A beautiful garden is one of life’s simplest and most rewarding pleasures. Bright and vibrant flowers, beautiful rustling leaves and soft, lush grass all come together to create your own personal paradise.

But as time goes on, all those leaves and lawn trimmings eventually make their way down to the ground, and once the kids are tired of playing in them, it’s time to grab the rake and get to work.

When it comes to gardening, raking leaves and lawn debris can be the most frustrating of chores. Gathering the leaves and debris isn’t all that difficult, it’s sweeping them all into those big, bulky leaf bags that’s the problem.

A Perfect Solution

That’s why we created the BigMouth Leaf and Lawn Bag Holder. Made from durable, heavy-duty corrugated plastic, it can be assembled in seconds and holds your leaf bag wide open, making leaf stuffing a breeze!

The convenient BigMouth Leaf and Lawn Bag Holder design more than doubles the opening area of your leaf bag, allowing you to quickly funnel a huge amount of leaves and other debris into the bag for easy disposal.

Convenience & Efficiency

Instead of constantly bending over to hold your leaf bag open as you fill it, simply fasten the three snaps on either side of the BigMouth Leaf and Lawn Bag Holder, slide it into the leaf bag, and watch it transform into a convenient, always-open container. Say hello to quick and easy yard work and goodbye to back pain!

Our Leaf and Lawn Bag Holder doesn’t just cut leaf clearing time in half, it also helps you make the most out of every leaf bag. The full-length chute keeps the bag completely open at all times, making it easy to compress the leaves and debris inside to make room for more. You’ll be surprised at how much a single leaf bag can actually hold!

When the job’s done, simply undo the snaps and fold everything neatly away for compact and easy storage.

description:
About Reli. Oxo-Biodegradable Trash Bags:

Each trash bag uses ASTM 6954-certified EPI TDPA additives for oxo-biodegradability. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation.  EPI TDPA technology enables products made from polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP) and polystyrene (PS) to degrade at a controlled rate (over many years) when in an appropriate commercial compost facility environment including, for example, photo (sunlight), thermal (heat) and/or mechanical stress in the presence of oxygen, moisture, and microorganisms. Extent and quickness of degradation will depend on surrounding environment and product formulation; stated rates and extent of decomposition do not mean that the product will continue to decompose. Commercial compost facilities can be found throughout the United States, locatable via local governments and online search.

Examples of EPI TDPA Application: LDPE-TDPA oxidized samples go through significant biodegradation (50 – 60% by carbon dioxide evolution) over 18 months as mediated by soil micro-organisms. EPI TDPA-incorporated PE bags can speed up degradation by 100's to 1000's of times faster compared to conventional PE bags when tested under ASTM D5282 Outdoor Exposure Testing Guidelines. EPI TDPA can facilitate total degradation of polyethylene carrier bags within 24 - 36 months with the appropriate formulation and disposal environment.

Each case includes 500 Trash Bags developed and distributed using Reli's global and domestic operations to enable premium quality with wholesale quantity & prices.

All of the bags are green in color to provide a visually appealing look while indicating eco-friendliness and hiding trash bag contents.

description: The Safetyhouse's asbestos disposal bags meet industry standards, or better. They are printed with identifying symbols and verbiage stating that the contents as asbestos materials. These asbestos disposal bags are necessary for anyone who wishes to safely remove and properly dispose of asbestos from their home or business, keeping in mind that the goal is to keep exposure to asbestos to a minimum. Proper asbestos disposal bags are required in order to meet OSHA safety standards. These asbestos disposal bags come in black and clear. Asbestos disposal bags are made of industrial weight polyethylene and have an approved asbestos warning on them that says Danger/Contains Asbestos Fibers/Avoid Creating Dust/Cancer and Lung Disease Hazard. Regulations require that you put asbestos material into the asbestos disposal bags while it is still damp. The asbestos disposal bags should not have more than thirty to fifty pounds of material placed in them. You should check the rules for disposal of asbestos in your area to see what their regulations are for the weight of asbestos disposal bags. Many places require you to double bag your asbestos waste using the asbestos disposal bags and sealing each of the asbestos disposal bags with duct tape. Asbestos can never be disposed of in the regular trash, even if it is properly labeled. Disposal of asbestos is only allowed at certain locations, and there is a charge for disposing of asbestos, usually this depends on the weight of the asbestos you wish to dispose of. It must be properly contained in asbestos disposal bags and you must have the proper paperwork in order to dispose of your asbestos disposal bags. Some disposal locations are only open on certain days, so be sure to check this beforehand.

description: The Safetyhouse's asbestos disposal bags meet industry standards, or better. They are printed with identifying symbols and verbiage stating that the contents as asbestos materials. These asbestos disposal bags are necessary for anyone who wishes to safely remove and properly dispose of asbestos from their home or business, keeping in mind that the goal is to keep exposure to asbestos to a minimum. Proper asbestos disposal bags are required in order to meet OSHA safety standards. These asbestos disposal bags come in black and clear. Asbestos disposal bags are made of industrial weight polyethylene and have an approved asbestos warning on them that says Danger/Contains Asbestos Fibers/Avoid Creating Dust/Cancer and Lung Disease Hazard. Regulations require that you put asbestos material into the asbestos disposal bags while it is still damp. The asbestos disposal bags should not have more than thirty to fifty pounds of material placed in them. You should check the rules for disposal of asbestos in your area to see what their regulations are for the weight of asbestos disposal bags. Many places require you to double bag your asbestos waste using the asbestos disposal bags and sealing each of the asbestos disposal bags with duct tape. Asbestos can never be disposed of in the regular trash, even if it is properly labeled. Disposal of asbestos is only allowed at certain locations, and there is a charge for disposing of asbestos, usually this depends on the weight of the asbestos you wish to dispose of. It must be properly contained in asbestos disposal bags and you must have the proper paperwork in order to dispose of your asbestos disposal bags. Some disposal locations are only open on certain days, so be sure to check this beforehand.
